post.description: Idempotent by requestId. A repeated request returns the saved session or confirmed launch failure and never launches a second task. After a confirmed capacity rejection, wait retryAfterSeconds and use a new request ID to start again.

Error.description: Typed error without hidden Challenge or review answer data.

changedFiles.description: Files observed changed in the associated capture interval. This does not attribute each change to this command.

status.description: Observed means matching saved output, not proof of understanding. Not observed means no matching record, not proof the learner missed it.

possibleHarmfulActions.description: Command-pattern and timing associations. These do not establish the cause of an outage.

commandSeq.description: Command that requested this capture, not proof of who changed each file.

ProposalStatus.description: Accepted means terminal input acceptance, not successful command execution. Unknown delivery must not be resent automatically.

expiresAt.description: Fixed worker deadline. Retries never extend it.

RecordingState.description: Recording is separate from the session outcome. An incomplete recording has no final numeric score.
